text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English,

zh_hant: 你好，歡迎收聽《Real Easy English》

text: the podcast where we have real conversations.
zh: 这档播客里我们有真实的对话
zh_hant: 這檔播客裡我們有真實的對話

text: in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 用简单的英语来帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 用簡單的英語來幫助你學習。

text: I'm Neil, and with me is Georgie.
Hello.
Did you know that you can now watch a video of this podcast?
zh: 你知道吗，现在你可以观看这档播客的视频了？
zh_hant: 你知道嗎，現在你可以觀看這檔播客的影片了？

text: And you can read along with a transcript on our website.
zh: 而且你还可以在我们的网站上跟着文字稿一起读。
zh_hant: 而且你還可以在我們的網站上跟著文字稿一起讀。

text: Visit bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi, Georgie.
How are you?
I'm very well, thank you, Neil.
How are you?
How was your journey into work?
My journey into work was very good today, actually.
zh: 我今天上班路上很顺利，其实。
zh_hant: 我今天上班路上很順利，其實。

text: And we're actually talking about transport today.
zh: 我们今天正好在聊交通。
zh_hant: 我們今天正好在聊交通。

text: How was your journey to work?
My journey was quite easy this morning, actually.
zh: 我今天早上通勤挺轻松的，其实。
zh_hant: 我今天早上通勤挺輕鬆的，其實。

text: It isn't always.
And, Neil, we actually have a very similar commute, don't we?
zh: 而且，Neil，我们俩的通勤路线其实很相似，对吧？
zh_hant: 而且，Neil，我們倆的通勤路線其實很相似，對吧？

text: I get the Tube to work,
which in the UK is the underground train.
zh: 在英国，地铁就是地下火车。
zh_hant: 在英國，地鐵就是地下火車。

text: So I walk to the station around 15 to 20 minutes,
zh: 所以我走到车站大概15到20分钟，
zh_hant: 所以我走到車站大概15到20分鐘，

text: and then I get the underground train, one train,
zh: 然后坐地下火车，一辆车，
zh_hant: 然後坐地下火車，一輛車，

text: and then I change and then get another one,
and then I walk to work.
What about you?
I do that, but before,
your bit, I have to get a bus as well.
zh: 在你那段之前，我还得先坐公交。
zh_hant: 在你那段之前，我還得先坐公交。

text: Are you that far away from the station?
A couple of miles.
OK.
Three kilometres.
A bit too far to walk, then.
A bit too far to walk.
I have walked when the public transport has been unreliable.
zh: 公共交通不靠谱的时候我也走过。
zh_hant: 公共交通不靠譜的時候我也走過。

text: But normally I get the bus to the Tube stop,
zh: 但通常我会坐公交到地铁站，
zh_hant: 但通常我會坐公交到地鐵站，

text: and then I get on the Tube into work.
Lovely.
And do you like the Tube?
What do you think about it?
I think the Tube is very convenient,
actually, because the trains go very frequently.
So if you miss one, you can wait just a couple of minutes and get the next one.
zh: 所以如果你错过一班，等几分钟就能坐下一班。
zh_hant: 所以如果你錯過一班，等幾分鐘就能坐下一班。

text: And it's probably the quickest way to get into central London
zh: 而且这可能是进伦敦市中心最快的方式，
zh_hant: 而且這可能是進倫敦市中心最快的方式，

text: because there's so much traffic.
Driving is a really bad idea.
Yeah, I agree with you.
It is very reliable .
It's usually very easy.
The thing I don't like about it, especially in the morning at rush hour,
zh: 我不喜欢的是，尤其是早高峰的时候，
zh_hant: 我不喜歡的是，尤其是早高峰的時候，

text: is the number of people on the Tube.
The, the underground trains in London are very old.
They're very small.
And they are very crowded in the mornings.
So crowded means there's lots of people.
zh: 所以拥挤意味着人很多。
zh_hant: 所以擁擠意味著人很多。

text: We can also say packed .
Yeah.
And I really don't like being in a tight space
zh: 我真的很不喜欢在狭窄的空间里，
zh_hant: 我真的很不喜歡在狹窄的空間裡，

text: with lots of people in the mornings,
zh: 早上和很多人挤在一起，
zh_hant: 早上和很多人擠在一起，

text: so early in the morning.
Yeah, I agree,
but I'm lucky because I get on the Tube at the first stop,
zh: 但我很幸运，因为我在第一站上地铁，
zh_hant: 但我很幸運，因為我在第一站上地鐵，

text: so I always get a seat, but then by the time you get on,
zh: 所以总有座位，但等你要上车的时候，
zh_hant: 所以總有座位，但等你要上車的時候，

text: it is usually really packed .
And the closer you get into central London, the more packed it is.
You're squashed up against strangers.
zh: 你会被挤在陌生人中间。
zh_hant: 你會被擠在陌生人中間。

text: It's not always fun.
I hate it.
What about buses?
Do you like buses?
are OK.
They, in London again, they are quite frequent .
zh: 在伦敦，它们也挺频繁的。
zh_hant: 在倫敦，它們也挺頻繁的。

text: And that's convenient.
Not always.
I mean, they are, they're frequent ,
zh: 我的意思是，它们很频繁，
zh_hant: 我的意思是，它們很頻繁，

text: but they're more unreliable than trains, aren't they?
zh: 但比火车更不可靠，对吧？
zh_hant: 但比火車更不可靠，對吧？

text: There always seems to be roadworks near where I live,
zh: 我家附近总是有道路施工，
zh_hant: 我家附近總是有道路施工，

text: and when there are roadworks,
there are traffic lights and then there are delays on the buses.
zh: 就会有红绿灯，然后公交就会晚点。
zh_hant: 就會有紅綠燈，然後公交就會晚點。

text: So in the city, public transport can be great.
zh: 所以在城市里，公共交通可以很好。
zh_hant: 所以在城市裡，公共交通可以很好。

text: But what about when we go outside of the city?
What do you use to go to other parts of the UK?
zh: 你去英国其他地区用什么交通工具？
zh_hant: 你去英國其他地區用什麼交通工具？

text: If it's quite far, so if I'm going really far north,
zh: 如果很远，比如我要去很北的地方，
zh_hant: 如果很遠，比如我要去很北的地方，

text: maybe to Scotland or to, I don't know,
zh: 可能要苏格兰，或者我不知道，
zh_hant: 可能要蘇格蘭，或者我不知道，

text: Manchester or a northern city,
zh: 曼彻斯特或者某个北方城市，
zh_hant: 曼徹斯特或者某個北方城市，

text: it's probably better to get the train
because it's faster and I really like trains.
zh: 因为更快，而且我很喜欢火车。
zh_hant: 因為更快，而且我很喜歡火車。

text: You can relax.
It's a relaxing experience.
Some of my best travel experiences
zh: 我一些最好的旅行经历，
zh_hant: 我一些最好的旅行經歷，

text: have been on long distance trains.
Yeah?
Can you...
Where have you been that's been so fantastic on a train?
zh: 你在火车上去了什么地方那么棒？
zh_hant: 你在火車上去了什麼地方那麼棒？

text: Well, I once went from Prague to Moscow on a train.
zh: 我曾经坐火车从布拉格去莫斯科。
zh_hant: 我曾經坐火車從布拉格去莫斯科。

text: Wow.
Yeah.
What was that like?
Really exciting.
Why?
It took about three days,
and I was with some friends,
and we could eat and drink and look out the window.
The landscape changed frequently.
It was just exciting.
We had
reliable ,
zh: 它形容你可以信赖的东西，
zh_hant: 它形容你可以信賴的東西，

text: which describes something you can trust,
zh: 还有“unreliable”，形容你无法信任的东西。
zh_hant: 還有“unreliable”，形容你無法信任的東西。

text: and unreliable which describes something you can't trust.
zh: 我们听到了“frequent”，形容经常发生的事情。
zh_hant: 我們聽到了“frequent”，形容經常發生的事情。

text: We heard frequent , which describes something that happens often.
And we also heard delayed ,
zh: 意思是像公共交通这样，比预期来得晚。
zh_hant: 意思是像公共交通這樣，比預期來得晚。

text: which means something, like public transport, comes later than expected.
zh: 这就是本期《Real Easy English》的全部内容。
zh_hant: 這就是本期《Real Easy English》的全部內容。

zh: 别忘了访问我们的网站，那里有免费的练习表，
zh_hant: 別忘了訪問我們的網站，那裡有免費的練習表，

text: Don't forget to go to our website where you can get a free worksheet
zh: 可以下载来测试你学到的东西。
zh_hant: 可以下載來測試你學到的東西。

text: to download to test what you've learnt.
It's at bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 下次我们会聊一年中的不同时节。
zh_hant: 下次我們會聊一年中的不同時節。

Spring, summer, autumn and winter.
See you then.
Goodbye.
Bye.
